cohort: Women who delivered at the Soroka University Medical Center, including 1463 cases with pelvic organ prolapse and 5637 controls without
finding: Obstetrics characteristics associated with pelvic organ prolapse included vaginal delivery and birthweight along with non-obstetrical factors such as prior surgery, while no association was found between preterm birth and pelvic organ prolapse.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was associated with an increased risk of pelvic organ prolapse.
birth_weight: Birthweight was associated with pelvic organ prolapse.
